answer_1.quote: We study the efficacy of LLMs in generating SCEs via three research questions... We test seven LLMs (7B-70B) across six datasets and four tasks.

answer_2.quote: We use the following metrics for evaluating SCEs... Counterfactual validity (Val) measures the percentage of times the SCE actually produces the intended target label... Edit distance (ED) measures the edit distance between the original input x and the counterfactual x CE.

answer_3.quote: Finally, we ask the model to make a prediction on its generated counterfactual, namely, ŷ CE = f (x CE )... We denote the validity without context as Val and with context as Val C.
models: Same LLMs used for generation (Gemma, Llama, Mistral, DeepSeek)

answer_4.quote: We conducted a human annotation study... Each example was independently assessed by two annotators (the authors), who determined whether the SCE yielded a solution matching the correct target label.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators assessed whether SCEs produced solutions matching target labels; disagreements resolved through discussion
